transcript_lines.speaker: Ananya (Skila AI)
transcript_lines.text: Namaskaram sir, nenu Skila AI nunchi automated AI assistant ni. Mee school kosam educational technology solution gurinchi short ga maatladataniki call chestunnanu. Ippudu maatladataniki convenient ga unda?

transcript_lines.speaker: Principal
transcript_lines.text: Namaskaram andi, maa school lo 750 students unnaru, kani digital tools sarigga levu.

transcript_lines.speaker: Ananya (Skila AI)
transcript_lines.text: Great sir, 750 students unna school ki maa AI books and personalized learning tool chaala effective ga work chestundi. Currently mee school lo edaina digital LMS platform use chestunnara?

transcript_lines.speaker: Principal
transcript_lines.text: Sure demo arrange cheyyandi, weekend chudam.

transcript_lines.text: Chaala santhosham sir! Maa Senior Academic Consultant meeku demo ivvadaniki connect avtaru. Mee WhatsApp number ki details and schedule share chestunnanu. Mee valuable time ichinanduku chaala dhanyavaadalu sir!
